title: Filtered module colimits commute with cochain homology
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $D$ a small filtered category and $F:D\to\operatorname{CoCh}_{\ge0}(\operatorname{Mod}_R)$ a diagram of nonnegative cochain complexes. For every $q\in\mathbf N$ there is an $R$-linear isomorphism $\operatorname{colim}_{d\in D} H^q(F(d))\cong H^q(\operatorname{colim}_{d\in D} F(d))$. Colimits of complexes are computed degreewise.

proof.text: Form the short complex S in the diagram category D ⥤ ModuleCat R by applying ShortComplex.functorEquivalence.inverse to the degree-q short complexes of F. The canonical homology comparisons S.mapHomologyIso for evaluation at each d give a natural isomorphism from the diagram d ↦ H^q(F(d)) to S.homology. Naturality follows from ShortComplex.homologyMap_mapNatTrans.

ModuleCat.AB gives AB5; shrink its universe using AB5OfSize_of_univLE. Hence colim is exact, and S.mapHomologyIso colim identifies colim(S.homology) with the homology of S.map colim. The latter short complex has the same objects and arrows as the degree-q short complex of HomologicalComplex.coconeOfHasColimitEval F. ShortComplex.isoMk and homologyMapIso identify their homologies. Finally the uniqueness isomorphism from HomologicalComplex.isColimitCoconeOfHasColimitEval identifies that explicit degreewise complex with colimit F. Compose these isomorphisms.
